checks.reason: The proposed idiomatic text renders every clause of 蘭復攻柳城，為飛梯、地道，圍守二旬，石琮躬勒將士出擊，敗之，斬首千五百級，蘭乃遁歸. It restores 復攻柳城 (Liucheng, again), 飛梯 (flying ladders), 躬勒將士 (personally led his officers and men), 敗之 (defeated him) and 斬首千五百級 (fifteen hundred heads, not 'killed men'). 遁歸 becomes 'fled home'. The current text drops the place, the personal leadership and the victory, and it blurs the head count. It also wrongly makes the twenty days pass before the sortie, while 圍守二旬 is the length of the siege. The name 'Duan Lan' is kept from the current text and matches 段蘭 in s0062. No date, person or Chinese text is changed.
checks.after: Duan Lan attacked Liucheng again, using flying ladders and tunnels, and kept up the siege for twenty days; Shi Cong personally led his officers and men out to strike, defeated him, and took fifteen hundred heads, and Lan then fled home.

checks.reason: In 斬首千五百級, 級 is the classifier for severed heads in a casualty count. 'Beheaded fifteen hundred grades' is a definite mistranslation, and 'took fifteen hundred heads' is correct. The rest of the literal sentence is unchanged word for word. The grade senses in s0109 (各有差) and s0112 (三等之田) are different words and are correctly left alone.
checks.after: Lan again attacked Liucheng, made flying ladders and tunnels, besieged and guarded twenty days; Shi Cong personally led officers and soldiers out to strike, defeated them, and took fifteen hundred heads; Lan then fled and returned.

checks.reason: In 斬級數千, 級 again counts severed heads, so 'took several thousand heads' correctly replaces 'beheaded several thousand grades'. This matches the idiomatic field, which already says 'took thousands of heads'. Only that clause changes. Lingzhi, Liao, Duan Lan, the battle and the more than five thousand households are all kept.
checks.after: Huang led the various armies to attack Liao’s cities north of Lingzhi; Liao sent his general Duan Lan to resist; great battle, defeated them, took several thousand heads, plundered over five thousand households and returned.

cautions: This is an editorial review of English wording only. It is not approval of any date, identity, chapter or publication.

I checked neighbouring units s0027, s0029, s0061, s0063, s0109 and s0112 and found no definite English defect. s0061 idiomatic ('to join the war') adds a little to 總眾而至, but that is a style point, not a definite error, so it is not filed.
Shi Cong (石琮) and Duan Lan (段蘭/蘭) keep their existing renderings. This review does not identify or merge any person.
